connector.name: KnowBe4
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for KnowBe4 security awareness training - users, groups, training, phishing campaigns.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image knowbe4-mcp:v1.1.1. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the wyre-technology account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: KNOWBE4_API_KEY
env.description: KnowBe4 Reporting API token (Bearer token from KnowBe4 console)

env.name: KNOWBE4_REGION
env.description: KnowBe4 region: 'us', 'eu', 'ca', 'uk', or 'de' — selects API base URL

env.name: KNOWBE4_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the KnowBe4 API base URL — auto-derived from region if omitted

env.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
env.description: Transport mode for the server. Set to 'stdio' for local CLI use; the image defaults to 'http' for gateway hosting.

env.name: AUTH_MODE
env.description: Credential source: 'env' reads vars locally, 'gateway' expects header injection from the WYRE MCP Gateway.

env.name: LOG_LEVEL
env.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error
